rules.name: registry publication is not production admission
rules.requirement: External registry or catalog publication is discovery/publication evidence only. Local FA3 production admission requires immutable identity, integrity/provenance checks and authoritative local policy admission.

rules.name: skill and context are not execution authority
rules.requirement: Skill/context availability, capability exposure, authorization, approval, sandboxing and verification are distinct control layers. Activation of one layer MUST NOT imply authority in another.

rules.name: agent assertion is not completion evidence
rules.requirement: An agent, builder or provider MUST NOT self-authorize PASS, CONFORMANT, ACCEPTED, PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE or PROMOTED. Such states require deterministic evidence-backed gates independent of the actor claim.

rules.name: attributable execution evidence
rules.requirement: Material execution evidence MUST bind command/argv, working directory, actor identity, capability/request identity, input/output artifact identity, exit status and environment identity.

rules.name: positive negative and boundary conformance
rules.requirement: Protocol/security-critical conformance requires positive evidence, negative/refusal evidence and boundary evidence. Happy-path PASS alone is insufficient.

rules.name: raw boundary and adapter projection evidence
rules.requirement: For boundary-critical protocols, raw wire/boundary evidence and normalized SDK/adapter projection evidence MUST both be available and attributable to the same exchange.

rules.name: ingress origin egress trace
rules.requirement: Gateway/proxy transformations that affect security or semantics MUST preserve correlated ingress, origin and egress evidence.

rules.name: compatibility downgrade fail closed
rules.requirement: Failure of a preferred protocol/API/security mode MUST NOT automatically authorize legacy fallback. Downgrade requires explicit permission, bounded scope, exact target version and compatibility evidence.

rules.name: redact before persistence
rules.requirement: Secrets and sensitive fields MUST be redacted before serialization, hashing, logging, persistence or artifact upload.

rules.name: rollback readiness before promotion
rules.requirement: Where rollback is applicable, promotion requires an exact rollback target, immutable artifact identity, health evidence, route-restoration procedure and trusted readiness evidence before deployment.

rules.name: progressive disclosure without authority escalation
rules.requirement: Discovery MAY expose minimal metadata, but branch-specific context/resources MUST be materialized only after activation and MUST NOT confer policy, identity, secret, network, host-resource or execution authority.
